title: Paired readout comparison
purpose: Record a bounded comparison between two independent channels that share a documented starting state and receive the same input.
inputs: two independent channels with separate reset controls
one input token that can be applied identically to both channels
applicability_preconditions: Both channels can be reset independently to the same documented starting counter.
The same input token can be applied once to each channel during one fixture cycle.
The starting values and fixture-cycle identifier can be recorded before the input is applied.
steps: Record each channel identifier, starting counter, input token, and shared fixture-cycle identifier.
Reset each channel to the same documented starting counter and record the resulting value.
Apply the identical input token once to each channel within the same fixture cycle.
Record each ending counter and output marker separately; leave any unrecorded value unknown.
stop_conditions: Stop if either channel cannot be returned to the documented common starting counter.
Stop if the input token or fixture-cycle identifier differs between channels.
If a required value is absent, report that this procedure cannot be completed from the available record.
